jobs.title: Regional Field Manager, Ohio - Toledo
jobs.description_text: Americans for Prosperity (AFP) is the premier grassroots organization focused on advocating solutions to the country’s greatest challenges. We recognize that tens of millions of Americans are frustrated with the extreme partisanship in government that keeps common-sense reforms from being passed, and instead seek to stand with policy leaders who are committed to finding a better way. Americans for Prosperity is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. This role can be based in the Toledo and Lucas County area. As a Regional Field Manager on our Americans for Prosperity-Ohio team, you will identify, recruit, and engage grassroots leaders in Ohio, mobilize them to take action, and drive policy reforms that open opportunities for all. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $50,000–$65,000 per year.

jobs.description_text: Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. Are you a proven sales enablement leader who knows how to turn firsthand selling experience into stronger capabilities across an entire team? As the Sales Enablement Director, you will build and build a comprehensive enablement strategy for our Development team, accelerating productivity, strengthening fundraising capabilities, and creating scalable onboarding and continuous learning programs that help our teams build meaningful, long-term partnerships. Reporting to the Head of Development Operations and leading the Development Enablement team, you will manage the Content Manager and Devo Compass Owner while helping shape the future structure of the enablement function. You will work closely with Development leadership, Partnership Advisor and Partnership Success Manager supervisors, content owners, Marketing, IT, and Development Operations. The ideal candidate combines significant experience in complex, consultative sales with a demonstrated ability to build learning programs, coach experienced sellers, and drive measurable performance improvements. Location: Arlington, VA For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $175,000-$225,000 per year.

jobs.title: Senior Partnerships Manager
jobs.description_text: Empowered is a community of social entrepreneur teachers, bringing the experiential, individualized, self-discovery teaching methodology to life in their classrooms. Their work leads to transformative learning experiences for their students. At scale, the Empowered community is a cultural movement driving bottom-up change throughout the key institution of education. Empowered is part of the Stand Together philanthropic community. Empowered is seeking a Senior Partnerships Manager to develop talent, advance strategy, and lead high-value relationships that strengthen our Partnerships capability and create value for educators, partners, and the organization. In this role, you will lead and develop a high-performing Partnerships team, drive execution of an established vision and strategy, and build the knowledge needed to evolve the capability over time. You will manage your own portfolio of partnerships and contribute to other partnership opportunities where your experience and perspective can add value. As a member of Education Operations leadership, you will contribute beyond Partnerships by bringing external knowledge, challenging assumptions, and helping translate organizational priorities into action. This role is based in Wichita, Kansas. For this role, the anticipated base salary range is $70,000–$100,000 per year.

jobs.title: Onsite Administrative Assistant
jobs.description_text: About Tahoe Therapeutics Tahoe Therapeutics is a biotechnology company working on building the ground truth for biological superintelligence. Our Mosaic platform is the first to make in vivo data generation scalable, with single-cell resolution, allowing us to map how drugs affect patient-derived cells in the body across a wide range of biological contexts. We are building the world’s largest in vivo single-cell perturbation atlas — and using it to train multimodal foundation models that learn the context-dependent nature of gene function, disease progression, and drug response. By combining cutting-edge machine learning with the most biologically relevant datasets ever assembled in drug discovery, our mission is to find better drugs, faster — and bring them to more patients who need them. Your Role We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and resourceful Onsite Administrative Assistant for our South San Francisco office. This individual will ensure day-to-day administrative and facility operations run smoothly and act as a liaison between internal teams and external vendors/service providers, particularly in support to our executive leadership. The ideal candidate will possess exceptional multitasking abilities, strong interpersonal skills, and a keen eye for detail, contributing to the efficiency and success of our organization. jobs.title: Advanced Product and Solutions Lead
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Advanced Product and Solutions Lead will play a key role in technical customer engagements by managing product customization requests and elaborating detailed technical content, across both commercial and defense segments. The Lead will work with customer engagement teams, including Customer Solutions and Sales Engineering, to translate advanced customer needs into Lightspeed deliverables and provide advanced support to customers and partners (e.g. technical deep dives). The role sits within the Product Management organization for Telesat Lightspeed and works closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Sales, Customer Solutions, Operations and ecosystem partners. The role will work across the range of products and solutions offered by Lightspeed, including connectivity services, value-added services, security services, private infrastructure offerings, user terminals, and third-party integrations. This role requires strong technical depth, strong solutioning skills, a product mindset, and the ability to translate customer and market needs into scalable, commercially viable services. Resource is expected to be onsite at Telesat HQ, a minimum of 4 days per week.

jobs.title: Communication Systems Engineer
jobs.description_text: As part of the Canadian Sales Engineering team, the Communication Systems Engineer is responsible for end-to-end design, costing, implementation, and ongoing support of advanced satellite and terrestrial communication solutions in response to customer requirements and internal projects. The successful candidate will develop integrated satellite RF and IP networking solutions utilizing the Telesat Lightspeed Low Earth Orbit (LEO) constellation. The role combines systems engineering, customer engagement, solution architecture, and field implementation to deliver reliable, high-performance communications networks.

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Software Architect - User Terminals will define and lead the software architecture for Telesat military and government satellite communication terminal solutions. The role provides technical leadership across programs, ensuring software designs meet system, security, operational, and long-term product requirements.

jobs.title: LS1070 - Senior Account Executive, Andean Region
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

The candidate will be responsible for monitoring and ensuring high software quality standards throughout the systems development lifecycle and for supporting the operation of Telesat's Lightspeed production and test environments. Working closely with the Platform Engineering, Development, and IT PMO teams, the candidate will help plan, coordinate, and execute testing and production release activities while ensuring alignment with project schedules and operational requirements. The successful candidate will develop and maintain performance metrics, analyze results and trends, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Candidates must reside in the Ottawa area or be willing to relocate. Relocation assistance will be provided to qualified candidates.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Canada Defence — Client & Program (ESCPP)
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com We are looking for an exceptional Senior Director to be the single face of this program from Telesat to DND – owning the customer relationship and orchestrating delivery from build through to operational service. If you are energized by high-stakes defence programs, thrive at the intersection of customer, commercial and engineering, and want to help shape a nation’s strategic communications capability, this is a rare and career-defining role. This is as much a technical and program-delivery leadership role as it is a customer role: you will bring genuine engineering fluency and deep program management discipline to steer a complex, multi-segment space and ground system from build through to in-service operation.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Delivery Lead
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The Senior Engineering Delivery Manager is responsible for driving integrated engineering execution across the Core User Terminal (Core UT) platform. This role serves as the central coordination point across multiple engineering disciplines, ensuring software, hardware, integration, test, and release activities are aligned to deliver predictable, high-quality outcomes. Working within the User Terminal Engineering organization, the Senior Engineering Delivery Manager partners closely with Engineering Managers, Product Management, Program Management, Systems Engineering, Verification & Validation, Architecture teams, and the Solution-level Release Train Engineer (RTE) to manage cross-functional dependencies, integration readiness, execution risks, and release delivery. As the delivery lead for the Core UT segment, the role provides execution visibility, dependency management, release readiness, and milestone status into the broader Lightspeed Solution Train, ensuring alignment with solution-level objectives, Program Increment commitments, and release plans. This role focuses on engineering execution leadership and delivery coordination rather than direct people management, product ownership, project management, or architectural decision-making.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Embedded Software
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com In this role, the successful candidate will be responsible to build, lead, and manage a team of software professionals, including Principal Engineers, SW. Architects, Software Engineers, Associate Engineers, as well as Scrum Masters. The right candidate will develop strategies for the embedded SW development environment, including goals and plans in alignment with the group's development objectives. They will organize and lead scrum team events (with the help of the Scrum Master), foster a collaborative and motivated work environment, and enable and support data-driven decision-making. In addition, they will provide mentorship, guidance, and career development opportunities to team members. This is a highly technical role, focused on using embedded SW development experience to successfully manage this team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Program Management Office
jobs.description_text: The Senior Manager, Project Management Office (PMO) reports to the Director of Mission Assurance and Program Integration and is responsible for leading enterprise program governance, integrated schedule and budget planning, program controls, portfolio reporting, and cross-segment coordination for complex telecommunications and space programs. This role provides the framework, tools, processes, and oversight necessary to enable successful program delivery across multiple organizational segments while ensuring executive leadership has clear visibility into program performance, risks, dependencies, milestones, and strategic objectives. The Senior Manager, PMO has a staff who serve as the central integrators across engineering, operations, supply chain, finance, mission assurance, product management, and other stakeholder organizations supporting multiple projects. The position does not directly manage segment Program Managers, who remain within their respective organizations and coordinate extensively with the PMO, However, the role establishes program management standards, methodologies, reporting requirements, and governance practices across the enterprise. The successful candidate must be comfortable operating in an evolving environment where not all processes, standards, and organizational interfaces have been fully established, and where success requires building structure, alignment, and operational discipline across multiple stakeholders.

The role will ensure that existing Lightspeed capabilities are reused where appropriate while identifying and defining program-specific enhancements required for ESCP-P.

jobs.title: Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Telesat's System Modeling team architects, develops, and maintains the Lightspeed System Model, an advanced engineering software platform that supports resource allocation modeling for Lightspeed operations and end-to-end performance evaluation of the Telesat Lightspeed satellite constellation. As a Systems Engineering Specialist, you will help lead the technical direction of the Lightspeed System Model. You will design, implement, and validate algorithms and optimization methods, contribute to performance assessments, and guide architectural decisions that support the constellation's success. You will develop engineering software in C++, mentor engineers, and collaborate across teams to align the model with system requirements and integrate it into the overall Lightspeed system.

jobs.title: Technical Program Integration Lead
jobs.description_text: The Technical Program Integration Lead serves as the focal point for integrated planning and execution within a major program segment, product area, or technical domain This role bridges technical complexity and program execution by transforming multiple engineering, product, software, hardware, operations, integration, and supplier workstreams into a cohesive, executable, and measurable program plan. Working across technical teams, systems engineering, program management, and program controls organizations, the Senior Technical Program Integration Lead ensures scope, dependencies, risks, readiness criteria, and delivery commitments are accurately represented within the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) and broader program framework Unlike a traditional Project Manager or Integrated Program Controls Analysts, this role drives technical planning maturity, cross-functional alignment, and execution discipline while ensuring technical teams operate as a fully integrated part of the overall program The role is accountable for establishing and maintaining a credible, integrated execution plan, identifying, and proposing workarounds and mitigations for risks and dependencies early, and enabling leadership to make informed decisions based on clear assessments of program readiness and execution health Success in this position requires strong technical acumen, systems-level thinking, and the ability to influence diverse stakeholders toward a common execution strategy

jobs.title: User Terminal Program Manager, Mil-Ka
jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: As User Terminal (UT) Program Manager, Mil-Ka, this position will join the User Terminal development team responsible for the development, integration, qualification, delivery, and deployment of Mil-Ka user terminal solutions supporting Telesat Lightspeed government and defence programs. The UT Program Manager, Mil-Ka will lead the programmatic execution of external vendor terminal development programs and serve as a primary interface between Telesat and its user terminal suppliers. The role will coordinate closely with Telesat engineering, product management, systems engineering, PMO, procurement, contracts, and other stakeholders to ensure terminal solutions meet technical, schedule, cost, quality, and program objectives. This role requires a seasoned program manager with demonstrated experience managing complex satellite communications or similar hardware/software development programs through design, integration, verification, manufacturing readiness, delivery, and deployment. Experience developing satellite communications equipment or user terminals for government, defence, or other mission-critical applications is highly desirable. jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, Platform Infrastructure (Foundations)
jobs.description_text: ABOUT THE ROLE Anyscale is seeking a Staff Software Engineer to lead the technical vision for our Infrastructure team. We create solutions for developers that help to integrate payments, attract users, and publish games all over the world. We also provide round-the-clock technical support. We are trusted by such giants as Twitch, Valve, Epic Games, Take2 and many more. As a Business Development Manager at Xsolla you will be responsible for researching, understanding, and selling Xsolla's products and solutions to clients in Global. Your primary functions will be sourcing and building new partnerships with individuals in the video game community and closing deals. Since this role is connected to the company strategy you will be able to influence decisions on a global level and the director role.

The right person for this role will be personable, organized, and confident engaging senior industry stakeholders, with a strong instinct for the kind of content and touchpoints that keep a community engaged between events. The best candidate will be someone comfortable owning outcomes rather than just relationships — proactively strategizing with partners, coordinating across internal teams to get campaigns right, and stepping in to help close deals when local presence and trust matter more than a remote pitch. Full ownership of the sales process (sourcing, pitching, commercial negotiation) sits with the Core China/APAC Team; this role isn't required to run a deal end-to-end, but is expected to help get opportunities over the line and make sure they deliver once signed. If you're excited about building a new function from the ground up, becoming a product expert partners and internal teams rely on, and working across both Chinese and global creator platforms as publishers look to expand their reach, we would love to hear from you!

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer Smart Wallet & Account Abstraction
jobs.description_text: About Xsolla Xsolla is a global commerce company with robust tools and services to help developers solve the inherent challenges of the video game industry. About the Role We're looking for a Staff Engineer to own the smart wallet and account abstraction layer of Xsolla's Web3 platform. This is an individual contributor role with outsized technical scope: you'll be the technical anchor for how millions of players get an on-chain account they never have to think about — setting direction, making hard architectural calls, and raising the bar across the org. Concretely, you'll own the account model behind Xsolla ZK, our zkSync-based L2, and the wallet that sits inside Xsolla App. Every player who signs in with Xsolla ID receives a deterministic, non-custodial smart account — derived from their identity claim, identical on every device, with private keys that never leave the client. That account is not a separate "wallet" screen: it is the player's inventory, and it backs minting, gifting, trading on our Bazaar marketplace, Merkle-based reward airdrops, gas sponsorship, and an in-app dApp browser that exposes the same signer to third-party applications through an EIP-1193 provider. You'll own the primitives underneath all of it: the ERC-4337 user operation lifecycle, EIP-7702 delegation, session keys and origin-bound Smart Sessions, paymaster and gas abstraction strategy, and the custody and recovery roadmap — including the move from raw key export to MPC custody. You will work closely with Engineering, UX, and customers to identify high-impact problems, define requirements, and ship solutions that balance ease of use with the rigor demanded by a highly regulated industry.

This role is for a hands-on, self-starter who thrives on balancing performance, cost, and reliability. jobs.description_text: The Role This is a top software engineering job that incorporates everything you’ve worked so hard for. Your impact as a technical problem-solver will mean you will be focused on building software that can not only scale for heavy use, but that can also evolve with new features and capabilities. jobs.description_text: Über Simplyright Simplyright hilft Menschen, die Ärger mit Abos, Kündigungen oder Inkasso-Schreiben haben. Das bringst du mit Viel Einfühlungsvermögen und Geduld. Du bleibst ruhig, auch wenn es am Telefon mal laut wird. Gutes Deutsch für Telefongespräche. Ein Akzent ist überhaupt kein Problem, perfektes Deutsch brauchst du nicht. Du bist zuverlässig, denkst mit und hältst, was du versprichst. Idealerweise Erfahrung im Kundenservice, Beschwerdemanagement oder Callcenter. Quereinsteiger mit dem richtigen Gespür sind ebenfalls willkommen. Du kannst zu deutschen Geschäftszeiten (Mo–Fr) arbeiten. Ein ruhiger Arbeitsplatz, stabiles Interne

Met jouw technische kennis los je storingen op en maak je iedere lift klaar voor gebruik. jobs.title: Liftmonteur Buitendienst
jobs.description_text: Job Description Ben jij klaar om jouw carrière naar grote hoogte te tillen? Stap in als Liftmonteur! Van woontorens tot grote infraprojecten: jij werkt op unieke locaties door heel Nederland en zorgt ervoor dat onze bouwliften veilig en betrouwbaar functioneren. Samen met ervaren collega's monteer en demonteer je tijdelijke personen- en goederenliften, voer je onderhoud uit en zorg je ervoor dat onze liften veilig en betrouwbaar functioneren. jobs.title: Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting
jobs.description_text: Job Description Jij steekt graag je handen uit de mouwen en zorgt dat alles onder de grond én op de bouwplaats goed geregeld is — samen maken we het werk klaar. Jouw baan als Grondwerker bij RECO Als Grondwerker Bouwplaatsinrichting bij RECO werk je elke dag buiten op verschillende bouwplaatsen in Nederland. Samen met collega’s zorg je ervoor dat alles wat nodig is op en rond de bouwplaats goed wordt voorbereid en aangelegd. Je doet graafwerk, legt voorzieningen aan en helpt mee bij technische werkzaamheden. Je werkt vaak samen in een duo en bent bezig met praktisch werk waar je aan het einde van de dag duidelijk resultaat van ziet. Geen dag is hetzelfde: de ene keer sta je op een nieuw project, de andere keer werk je verder waar je gisteren bent begonnen. Kort gezegd: jij maakt de bouwplaats klaar zodat anderen veilig en goed hun werk kunnen doen. Jouw belangrijkste werkzaamheden bestaan uit: ✅ Graaf- en grondwerk uitvoeren; ✅ Helpen bij het aanleggen van bouwplaats voorzieningen; ✅Ondersteunen bij elektrotechnisch en ander technisch werk; ✅Samenwerken met collega’s op verschillende locaties; ✅Zorgen dat het werk veilig en netjes gebeurt. Requirements Wat breng jij mee? 👍 Je bent fulltime (40 uur) beschikbaar 👍 Je bent fysiek fit en werkt graag buiten 👍 Je hebt een BE-rijbewijs (of bent bereid dit te halen) 👍 Je denkt praktisch en werkt graag met je handen Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met: ✅ Een goed salaris; ✅ 28 vakantiedagen per jaar, oplopend tot 31 dagen als waarde

Jouw takenpakket is uitdagend en breed: Lassen, zagen en boren van machineonderdelen; Het volledig en nauwkeurig assembleren van onze machines; Testdraaien en technisch controleren of alles perfect functioneert; Het snel en effectief oplossen van storingen; Incidenteel assisteren bij installaties op locatie bij de klant. Daarom vragen wij: Een afgeronde technische opleiding (minimaal MBO Mechatronica of Elektrotechniek) — maar werkervaring vinden we minstens zo belangrijk; Aantoonbare ervaring in de machinebouw of een vergelijkbare technische productieomgeving; Je werkt precies, ziet het werk liggen en hebt een proactieve werkhouding.
